result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' section is clipped mid-glyph despite having empty space to its right, and the horizontally scrollable category chip row shows a stray sliver of a next chip at the right edge. Other elements (header, promo banner, carousels, bottom nav) render correctly.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' list, the card title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is truncated mid-word ('Tokumaru Ramen' shows as 'Tokumaru Rameı' with the final letter cut) even though the rating badge '4.8 (500+)' sits on the same row with visible gap, so the title container appears over-constrained rather than ellipsized gracefully.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to ellipsize with proper text-overflow handling and reserve flexible width between the title and the rating row so the full name fits or truncates cleanly with an ellipsis instead of clipping glyphs.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ends with a barely visible sliver of another chip at the right screen edge, which reads as a rendering artifact rather than an intentional scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a fade/gradient mask so the partially visible next chip is either clearly peeking (e.g., 24-32px visible) or hidden, making the scroll hint intentional.
